package rulefixtures

import (
	"context"
	"fmt"
	"net/http"
)

// scenario for request_context_passed_to_background_task_without_detach: Background goroutines that still appear to inherit request-scoped context instead of detaching with context.WithoutCancel or equivalent.
// fixture polarity: positive; family: context; severity: warning.

func processJob(ctx context.Context, jobID string) {
	select {
	case <-ctx.Done():
		fmt.Println("context cancelled, aborting job", jobID)
		return
	default:
	}
	fmt.Println("processing job", jobID)
}

func scenario243Positive(w http.ResponseWriter, r *http.Request) {
	jobID := r.URL.Query().Get("job_id")
	go processJob(r.Context(), jobID)
	w.WriteHeader(http.StatusAccepted)
}
